title: The Uniform of Vilna
author: Theo Reyes
blurb: Mirabel Whitlock, a mapmaker's apprentice finishing the atlas the master died for, keeps a low profile and busy hands. Then the army requisitions the town and the ledger with all the names — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must get the truth on the record ahead of the victors' historians, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
